Subject: Revised MSA/Order Form redlines + DPA / SCCs annex

Hi Aditya / Laura —

Thanks for the call earlier this week. Attached are Helix's consolidated redlines to the MSA and Order Form, plus a proposed SCCs annex and a short transfer-impact addendum. The key asks from our side are:

- Clarify processor/controller split for "model training telemetry" (we flagged this as a potential controller activity in our redlines).
- Confirm whether Redwood will provide a rolling subprocessor list or commit to notice + objection rights in the DPA.
- Confirm that the SCCs annex will be incorporated by reference into the DPA (our legal prefers explicit annex language).

We have a procurement window: if documents are agreed by 2026-06-04 we can target a July 1 start on the Dedicated environment. If you need more time please flag now.

Attachments: Helix_Redlines_MSA_OrderForm_v3.docx, Proposed_SCCs_Annex_Helix.pdf

Can you confirm receipt and let us know which items need legal redlines versus commercial / procurement?

Thanks —
Emily Park
Head of Vendor Sourcing, Helix Health

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@helixhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-21 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Revised MSA/Order Form redlines + DPA / SCCs annex

Emily —

Received, thanks. Quick read-through and next-steps from our side:

1) Receipt & ownership: I’ll own the commercial coordination and timeline; Laura will handle legal redlines and Irene will own the SCCs/technical evidence asks.

2) Processor/controller split: We need the Helix view of the telemetry items called out in the redline (line refs would help). On our side: Redwood considers inference logs + aggregated usage metrics to be processor activities; anything that involves patient-identifiable datasets used to re-train models would be controller when Helix drives the training dataset.

3) Subprocessor approach: Redwood's standard DPA commits to a rolling subprocessor list via a published page + 30-day notice. We can accept objection rights for high-risk subprocessors with a mutual escalation path; cannot commit to a static pre-approved list. Is Helix willing to accept notice + objection?

4) SCCs annex: We generally incorporate SCCs by reference but are open to an explicit annex so long as it doesn't create contradictory liability buckets. Laura — please review Helix's annex and propose clean language where necessary.

5) Timeline: target OK to review legal redlines by end of day 2026-05-24. If Helix needs to compress, flag procurement priority.

I’ll circulate our redline pass once Laura has initial comments.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Head of BD, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0132

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, Emily Park <emily.park@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-21 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Revised MSA/Order Form redlines + DPA / SCCs annex

Aditya / Emily —

Read Helix's annex. High-level legal take and suggested next steps:

- On processor/controller: Helix has proposed blanket controller status for anything touching "training data". We should accept controller status only where Helix provides the dataset and directs training outcomes. Suggest replacing Helix's proposed clause with: "Customer shall be Controller for Customer-originated training datasets; Redwood will act as Processor for hosted inference and anonymized aggregate telemetry."

- SCCs annex: Helix's draft tries to extend warranties beyond the SCCs standard language (see section 2.1). We should push back and offer a clean annex that references the EU SCCs (as of date) and clarifies that any additional obligations are redlines and limited to data exports the parties expressly agree to in a transfer addendum. I'll attach our proposed annex and a short comment log.

- Transfer-impact addendum: Good idea to keep a short addendum for the specific Helix use-case (regions, subprocessor geography, on-prem fallbacks). Our proposed edits narrow the scope and add SLA-conditional fallback for region failover; see attached Transfer_Impact_Addendum_Draft.docx.

Action items:
- Emily: can Helix provide the redline line references for the telemetry examples so we can mark them in our proposed language?
- Irene: please review the Helix evidence asks in the annex and confirm which items we can provide as "standard evidence" vs. "additional evidence on request".

Irene — quick comment: Helix asks for KMS proof for key rotation. We can provide a certificate of KMS integration and SOC-2 encryption notes, but not raw KMS keys (obvious).

Attached: Redlines_Aditya_v2.docx, Transfer_Impact_Addendum_Draft.docx

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Legal (Commercial), Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

---

From: Emily Park <emily.park@helixhealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@helixhealth.com>, Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-22 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Revised MSA/Order Form redlines + DPA / SCCs annex

Laura / Aditya —

Thanks for the quick review and detailed notes. Answers inline below and a suggested compressed timeline.

On processor/controller: Helix can provide line refs this afternoon. Our intent is not to claim controller over routine inference telemetry; our redline flagged telemetry because certain telemetry fields currently include PII in our pilot dataset. We will mark the examples and confirm that Customer-originated training datasets remain customer-controlled.

On subprocessors: Helix accepts the rolling published list + 30 days notice approach, but requests that Redwood provide a head-of-security contact for objection handling and a committed escalation SLA (48 hours initial response). Is that acceptable?

On SCCs: Helix legal is comfortable with an annex by reference as long as the annex is explicitly attached as Exhibit B and dated. We can accept Redwood's proposed limited warranty carveouts if the language is mutual.

Procurement timeline: Helix can sign DocuSign if legal comments are exchanged by 2026-05-27. I’ve created a DocuSign package for your redline set: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/DocuSign-HLX-4821-Redlines (draft). Procurement will still need a purchase order post-signature, but this keeps the legal runway.

Attachments: updated Helix line refs (attached inline in this email as a short list)

Short-term asks / decisions (please confirm):
- Redwood to accept rolling subprocessor list + 30-day notice + escalation contact (Aditya: who to provide?)
- Laura to deliver mark-up to Helix annex by EOD 2026-05-24
- Aditya to confirm commercial acceptance of SLA conditional region fallback by 2026-05-24

Thanks —
Emily

Subject: Re: Revised MSA/Order Form redlines + DPA / SCCs annex

Emily / team —

Solid — thanks for the clarifications and the DocuSign draft. Confirming decisions and owners so nothing falls through the cracks: 

1) Subprocessor model: Redwood accepts rolling published subprocessor list + 30-day notice. Point of contact for objections / security bridge: security-bridge@redwood.com (initial SLA: 48 business hours to acknowledge, 5 business days to propose mitigation).

2) Processor/controller: Agreed in principle to Laura's proposed language. Laura will send the exact mark-up to Helix by EOD 2026-05-24. Helix to send telemetry line refs today.

3) SCCs annex: We will accept an Exhibit B annex by reference. Laura's team will propose mutually balanced language around warranties and liability caps.

4) Transfer-impact addendum: We will accept a narrowly scoped addendum for region/subprocessor geography + on-prem fallback. Irene — please prepare a short evidence manifest (SOC2 encryption note + KMS certificate stub) and mark which items are "on-request" vs "standard". Target EOD 2026-05-24.

5) Timeline / next steps:
- 2026-05-22: Aditya confirms escalation contact (done).
- 2026-05-22: Helix to upload telemetry line refs (Emily: thanks).
- 2026-05-24: Laura to deliver annex mark-up + Irene evidence manifest.
- 2026-05-27: Exchange final legal redlines.
- 2026-06-04: Procurement target for execution if redlines agreed.

HubSpot deal: HLX-4821 (I've updated the timeline and attached the redline artifacts). DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/DocuSign-HLX-4821-Redlines

If anyone needs to escalate, tag me and I'll loop in our Head of Security / CRO.

Thanks all —
